name: Raúl Mendoza
bio:
Raúl Mendoza's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent tinkering with engines in his grandfather's workshop in Guadalajara. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. After graduating, Raúl joined a small racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for problem-solving and optimizing car performance. He steadily climbed the ranks, gaining experience in various technical roles before joining Brad Jones Racing. 

As Technical Director, Raúl emphasizes a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and driver feedback to identify areas for improvement. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to motivate his team to achieve ambitious goals. Raúl's innovative thinking and commitment to pushing the boundaries of performance make him a valuable asset to Brad Jones Racing, constantly seeking out ways to improve the car's performance through both setup and component development.

Raúl stands out for his dedication to fostering a collaborative environment within the team, believing that open communication and shared knowledge are essential for success. He is always willing to mentor younger engineers, sharing his expertise and passion for motorsport. His focus is on creating a strong technical foundation for the team's future.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part
physical.description: Raúl is a man of medium height with a focused gaze and a confident posture.
